mkdir-one-folder.title: Create a Folder with `mkdir`
mkdir-one-folder.bodyMarkdown:
`mkdir` creates a directory without moving you into it.

```bash
mkdir reading-list
```

List the parent directory afterward to verify the new name.

mkdir-p-nested.title: Create Nested Paths with `mkdir -p`
mkdir-p-nested.bodyMarkdown:
`mkdir -p` creates missing parent directories along with the requested nested path.

```bash
mkdir -p travel-pack/tickets
```

It is useful when the parent path may not exist yet.

touch-files.title: Create Empty Files with `touch`
touch-files.bodyMarkdown:
`touch` creates an empty file when the named file does not already exist.

```bash
touch research/links.txt
```

The parent directory must already exist.
